digest.component_or_area: GitHub Actions workflows for main-branch CI
propositions: Cancelled workflow runs on main render as red X on GitHub despite the branch being healthy, misleading observers about actual merge safety
Main-branch CI triggered on every push causes runs to be superseded and cancelled as commits land close together
Per-commit attribution is lost when moving from push-triggered to scheduled CI; bisection recovery requires resolving the last-known-green SHA and reproducing the failure recipe from CI script

The push trigger must be removed for main in six workflows (test.yml, optionality.yml, verify-identity.yml, prompt-eval.yml, codeql.yml, terraform-drift.yml) while preserving push CI for non-main branches and keeping gerrit-verify gates unchanged
A 6-hour schedule cadence with staggered start minutes and workflow_dispatch on-demand dispatch provides the desired main-health signal without per-commit cancellation noise
